contexts: hospital headache clinic, about 1,900 migraine patients a year
reading: The diary sits upstream of three costs: appointment time, repeat appointments for deferred eligibility decisions, and, if documentation improves, more patients qualifying for expensive preventives. Completeness of electronic diaries has been compared already; the switch's costs and consequences have not.

nodes.label: Usable diary at the appointment
nodes.detail: Missing for about a third of patients.

nodes.label: Appointment length
nodes.detail: About 6 minutes longer without a diary (claim c2).

nodes.label: Deferred eligibility decisions
nodes.detail: 58 percent of patients without a usable diary (claim c1).

summary: Map of the diary's downstream costs and the switch's new costs.
